result.brief: 提出免训练的残差引导方法，通过在缓存外对新提示去噪上一分块并将残差注入下一分块早期去噪步，缓解流式视频生成中的上下文惯性，提升实时交互式提示切换能力。
result.reason: Training-free guidance for streaming real-time interactive video generation, addressing prompt-switch inertia in chunked autoregressive video diffusion; directly a video generation contribution.
